meta.name: setup-cms
meta.description: Connect a CMS to notfair SEO tools. Guides users through configuring WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, or Ghost — tests the connection, and writes credentials to .env.local. Once set up, seo-analysis automatically cross- references CMS content against Google Search Console data. Use whenever the user says "connect my CMS", "set up WordPress", "configure Strapi", "add Contentful", "connect Ghost", or "CMS setup". Also trigger if the user asks why no CMS data appears in a seo-analysis report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接你的 CMS 到 SEO 工具，自动同步内容数据
copy.tagline_en: Connect your CMS to SEO tools and sync content data automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, or Ghost and need SEO analysis

howto.what: 使用后,Claude会引导你连接WordPress、Strapi、Contentful或Ghost,测试连通性,并把凭据写入项目文件(.env.local)。之后SEO分析会自动把网站内容与Google搜索数据对照,找出不可见页面、内容缺口、陈旧文章和缺失的SEO字段。
howto.when: 当你说"连接我的CMS""配置WordPress""配置Strapi"等,或询问"为什么SEO报告里没有CMS数据"时触发。

say.note: Claude会询问网址、用户名和应用密码。

say.text: 为什么SEO报告里没有CMS数据？

howto.what_en: Claude helps you connect WordPress/Strapi/Contentful/Ghost, tests it, saves credentials to .env.local. Then seo-analysis cross-references CMS content with Google Search Console data to find invisible pages, gaps, stale posts, and missing SEO fields.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'connect my CMS', 'set up WordPress', 'configure Strapi', etc., or ask why no CMS data appears in a seo-analysis report.

say_en.note: Claude will ask for your site URL, username, and app password.
Claude will ask for your Space ID and API token.

say_en.text: Why is there no CMS data in my SEO report?
say_en.note: Claude will check your CMS connection settings.
